name: signalk-autoroute

scripts.build: tsc && tsc test/routing.test.ts --outDir dist-test --moduleResolution node --module es2022 --target es2022 --declaration --declarationMap --sourceMap --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck

signalK.name: signalk-autoroute
signalK.description: Offline-first nautical route planner with vessel-aware A* pathfinding

defaultAirDraft.title: Default Air Draft (m)

defaultCoastDistance.title: Default Min Coast Distance (NM)

fairwayMultiplier.title: Fairway Multiplier

wrongWayPenalty.title: Wrong Way Penalty
wrongWayPenalty.description: Penalty multiplier for traveling against traffic flow
